reports.title: Repligen Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Updates Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance

guidance.heading: FINANCIAL GUIDANCE FOR FULL YEAR 2026
section: Our financial guidance for the full year 2026 includes the expected impact of BioLife Solutions from the closing date of October 6, 2026. Our Adjusted (non-GAAP) guidance excludes the impact of any other potential business acquisitions and future fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates.

FY 2026 | Adjusted (non-GAAP)
Total Reported Revenue | $844M - $852M
Reported Growth | 14.5% - 15.5%
Organic Growth | 12% - 13%
Gross Margin | 53.7% - 54.2%
Income from Operations | $135M - $139M
Operating Margin | 16.0% - 16.3%
Other Income (Expense) | ~$18M
Adjusted EBITDA Margin | ~21%
Tax Rate on Pre-Tax Income | ~22%
Net Income | $119M - $122M
Earnings Per Share - Diluted | $2.05 - $2.09

Total reported revenue guidance reflects a neutral impact from foreign currency and an approximately 2.5 point tailwind from inorganic growth primarily from the BioLife acquisition net of the divestiture of Polymem.
